name: Analog Systems Laboratory
description: I- V characterisation of transistors and their simulation using SPICE, simulation of biasing and current mirror circuits and realizing them using a breadboard, design of a self-tuned filter, design of a function generator and its conversion into VCO/FM generator, design of a PLL, automatic gain control of an amplifier, design of a DC-DC converter and its characterization, design of an LDO, design of a digitally-controlled gain stage amplifier, design of a digitally-programmable square and triangular wave generator
